### Workflow handoff: urlshort-slice-delegated@1 step design_review

Workflow instance: 01M416ZY5N11CDGZBM2DT4GAXS
Prior step: design (design) closed by design-agent@urlshort-factory
This step: design_review (design_review)
Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Design ready on SPEC 7b753b7. Impact analysis a686b2a predates the design c1be728; b55c549 adds an ADR-0019 cross-slice note. Read design.md, impact-analysis.md, ADR-0019, docs/DESIGN.md Audit read row and stack facts, design-probe/ P1-P5. GET /api/audit: the handler first refuses (403) any X-Forwarded-For or Forwarded header or a peer that is not loopback; limit and cursor are validated per field (400); limit+1 rows newest first by id with a keyset; base64url cursor. No index and no migration (P5: the primary key is walked backwards, limit+1 reads at any depth), so neither w1 slice takes a Flyway number. One application.properties line: server.forward-headers-strategy=none. P4b: without it, on a detected cloud platform Tomcat's RemoteIpValve admits a forged X-Forwarded-For 127.0.0.2 (200); with it, 403. AuditLog is untouched. AC-20 and AC-21 induction: a held JDBC transaction; a spy on AuditTrail. Open for the lead at plan-lock: a one-line README grant (endpoint list).

Continuation: rig workflow project --instance 01M416ZY5N11CDGZBM2DT4GAXS --current-packet qitem-20261003174406-936f9d9c --exit <handoff|waiting|done|failed> --actor-session review-agent@urlshort-factory
Context: this workflow packet is a shortcut, not the whole story; inspect additional project, mission, and receipt evidence before choosing an authored exit.
closureTarget: Design FAIL on b55c549 (impact a686b2a, design c1be728), review commit 97e434a. DR-01 HIGH: native/framework override of the properties-file none default admits forged loopback forwarding headers; independent real-Tomcat controls reproduce it. Author acknowledged no decision permits the exception and proposed refusing unless effective ServerProperties strategy is NONE; verify both override modes and unset/cloud behavior. DR-02 MEDIUM: strict Accept selects safe 406 before promised guard/400 validation; reconcile precedence and add controls in passing. All 10 handed files reviewed; baseline offline check passes UP-TO-DATE, no candidate implementation claimed. Read docs/review/01-audit-read/design-review.md and proof/access-controls.txt; answer both findings, update ADR/shared contract and test mapping, then return exact revised SHA for focused re-review.
